1  REHABILITATION & RESETTLEMENT ACT, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT  AND AWARD DATED 16.04.2019 PASSED IN LAC NO.630/2017 ON  THE FILE OF THE I ADDITIONAL DISTRICT JUDGE, BELAGAVI,
 AWARDING THE COMPENSATION OF RS.6,03,000/- PER ACRE.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
 JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
 CORAM: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.T.NARENDRA PRASAD  AND THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VENKATESH NAIK T  -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:16028-DB  MFA No. 102903 of 2023  ORAL JUDGMENT

(PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.T.NARENDRA PRASAD) Learned AGA accepts notice for respondent Nos.1 and 2.
2.

This appeal is filed by the beneficiary of acquisition under Section 74(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act', for short) challenging the judgment and award dated 16.04.2019 and 27.04.2019 respectively passed in L.A.C. No.630/2017 by the learned I Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Belagavi, whereby the Reference Court fixed market value of the acquired land at the rate of Rs.6,03,000/- per acre.
3.

Accordingly, this appeal is dismissed in terms of judgment of this Court in M.F.A.
No.102543/2022, dated 23.09.2024.
